title: Silver Saver Account: Upgrading from Bronze Saver
summary: This document explains upgrades from the Bronze Saver to the Silver Saver Account: a $5.00 monthly maintenance fee applies, waived in any month your minimum daily balance is at least $10,000. It advises confirming you can consistently meet $10,000 before upgrading, monitoring your first statement, and contacting support if a waiver was incorrectly applied.
faqs: What is the monthly maintenance fee for the Silver Saver Account after upgrading?
When is the $5.00 monthly maintenance fee waived?
Before requesting an upgrade, what should I confirm about my balance?
How do I account for upcoming cash flows that might drop my daily balance below $10,000?
After upgrading, how should I verify the fee waiver and what should I do if I’m charged despite meeting the requirement?
